dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Imparting your experience is also an important part of the job.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: That's all I can do at this point. The real battlefield is thousands of times tougher than any training ground, so we've got to get every bit of preparation done right now.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: ...And when that day finally comes, I hope they can all take the field, certain they will win.
